protocol.name: iosc_iosurface

description.summary: zero-copy IOSurface buffers for Xios compositors

protocol.description: iOS has no DRM/dma-buf, and a mach send right cannot traverse Wayland fd passing. A GPU client shares its IOSurface by naming an IOSurfaceCreateMachPort port in its own task. The compositor authenticates the Wayland peer, imports that surface from the client task, and waits on a brokered MTLSharedEvent before sampling each committed frame.

interface.name: iosc_iosurface
interface.description: Every buffer is a BGRA8 IOSurface imported from the client task. Every commit is paired with a brokered MTLSharedEvent acquire fence; unfenced presentation is invalid.

entry.name: import_failed
entry.summary: the named mach port could not be imported as an IOSurface

entry.name: unsupported_format
entry.summary: the requested IOSurface format or flags are unsupported

entry.name: invalid_fence
entry.summary: the shared-event token or signal value is invalid

enum.name: format

description.summary: IOSurface pixel format and presentation flags

enum.description: The low bits identify the IOSurface pixel layout. The high bits are presentation flags. Unknown values are protocol errors.

entry.name: bgra8888_gl_origin
entry.summary: BGRA8 IOSurface rendered with GL-style bottom-left origin

entry.name: flag_top_left
entry.summary: buffer contents are already in top-left presentation order

request.name: create_buffer

description.summary: wrap a client IOSurface as a wl_buffer

request.description: Geometry is advisory; the compositor trusts the imported IOSurface. format is bgra8888_gl_origin plus optional flag_top_left.

request.name: set_acquire_fence

description.summary: set the brokered GPU acquire fence for the next commit

request.description: token is the fixed 32-byte capability for the producer's persistent MTLSharedEvent. value_lo/value_hi form the monotonically increasing value the compositor waits for before sampling this buffer.
